text_blocks.snippet: The treatment for COVID-19 depends on the severity of the infection and the patient's risk factors.

list.title: Antivirals:
list.snippet: These medications can help reduce the severity and duration of the illness. Examples include remdesivir (for hospitalized patients) and molnupiravir and paxlovid (for mild to moderate cases at home).

list.title: Monoclonal antibodies:
list.snippet: These antibodies can help prevent serious illness in high-risk patients who have recently been infected.
Oxygen therapy: For patients with moderate to severe symptoms who have difficulty breathing.
Intubation and mechanical ventilation: For critically ill patients who cannot breathe on their own.
Hospitalization: For patients who require close monitoring and medical care.
Vaccines: Vaccination is the best way to prevent severe illness from COVID-19.
Over-the-counter pain relievers: Such as ibuprofen or acetaminophen.

text_blocks.snippet: It's important to consult with a healthcare professional for proper diagnosis and treatment recommendations.
